{"metadata":{"description":"Aggregated web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one prioritized queue over AnySearch / TinyFish / Tavily with multi-key rotation and ordered fallback.","id":"gh:1343348077","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-search-aggregation","slug":"chendefine/dsh-web-search-aggregation","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","search-provider","tavily","web-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Aggregated web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one prioritized queue over AnySearch / Ti"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nyFish / Tavily with multi-key rotation and ordered fallback."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-aggregation"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · npm · GitHub"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An aggregated web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the built-in `web_search` tool is serv"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ed through **one prioritized queue over AnySearch / TinyFish / Tavily / Brave / Exa / Firecrawl / Ji"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"na / SerpApi / Serper** — each provider can hold a pool of API keys that rotate per request, every f"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ailed attempt falls through to the next provider or key, and the first success wins."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Prioritized queue, ordered fallback** — entries are tried top-down per request; the first one th"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"at returns wins, and a failed entry falls through to the next. Order is edited live in the settings "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"card; each provider kind can be queued at most once.
- **Multi-key pools with rotation** — every pro"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"vider reads exactly one credential (`ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` / `TINYFISH_API_KEY` / `TAVILY_API_KEY` / `B"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"RAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY` / `EXA_API_KEY` / `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` / `JINA_API_KEY` / `SERPAPI_API_KEY` / `S"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ERPER_API_KEY`) whose value holds all of that provider's keys joined by `,`. Within one entry the ke"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ys are tried in rotating order (round-robin per successful request), spreading load and quota across"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" the pool.
- **Works out of the box** — AnySearch allows anonymous access, so the queue answers sear"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ches before any key is configured. The shipped defaults simply enable all nine kinds — the order is "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"whatever you arrange in the card; the key-required entries fall through until their credential is se"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"t.
- **Budget-aware** — each attempt gets its own deadline (default 10 s, 1–60 s), so one hung upstr"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"eam cannot eat the tool-level budget; five to six full fallbacks still fit inside 60 s.
- **Transpar"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"ent failures** — when every attempt fails, the error reports each one (`[2] tavily/TAVILY_API_KEY#1:"},{"id":"p6s14","text":" 401 unauthorized; …`). An empty queue raises `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`; caller cancellation raises"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" `WEB_ABORTED` immediately.
- **Secret hygiene** — key literals are never logged and never appear in"},{"id":"p6s16","text":" failure records (which cite `REF` / `REF#N` labels only); the settings card shows keys as masked ta"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"gs and never echoes stored values back.
- **Live configuration** — the Plugins page (侧边栏 → 插件 → *dsh"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"-web-search-aggregation*, dsh ≥ 0.1.7) shows the full form right on the plugin's package page (and o"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"n the row's own page via its configure control); it edits the queue, keys, endpoints, and timeout, a"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"nd a committed change reaches the next search without a restart."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Half | Location | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Host (server) | `src/` | Registers the search provider (id `aggregated`) into `ctx.web`; `cordis.p"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"atch.yml` pins the web seam's `searchProvider` to it and inserts the plugin row carrying the default"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" queue. |
| Browser (client) | `src/client/` | Registers the *Aggregated web search* configuration p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"age on the Plugins page's `plugins.row.config` seat, which stages the queue and writes changes throu"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"gh the shared settings form + credentials services. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Nine adapters ship today; another upstream is one adapter module plus one registry row."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Kind | Auth | Default endpoint | Notes |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `anysearch` | Bearer, optional | `https://api.anysearch.com/v1/search` | anonymous access allowed;"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" `data.results[]` envelope |
| `tavily` | Bearer | `https://api.tavily.com/search` | sends `max_resu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"lts`; the generated answer rides `content` |
| `tinyfish` | `X-API-Key` | `https://api.search.tinyfi"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"sh.ai` | `GET ?query=…`; no count control, the seam's `maxResults` truncates |
| `brave` | `X-Subscr"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"iption-Token` | `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search` | `GET ?q=…&count=…` (count clamped"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" to 1–20, decorations off); `page_age` → `publishedAt` |
| `exa` | Bearer | `https://api.exa.ai/sear"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ch` | sends `numResults` (1–100) and `contents.highlights`; the first highlight is the snippet |
| `"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"firecrawl` | Bearer | `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/search` | sends `limit` (1–100); no `scrapeOptio"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ns` — plain results, no per-page scrape cost |
| `jina` | Bearer | `https://s.jina.ai` | `POST /` wi"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"th `{"q"}`; `X-Respond-With: no-content` keeps it SERP-only (no per-page fetch); `num` (1–20) only w"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"hen the request carries a count; `description` → snippet, `publishedTime` → `publishedAt`; EU mirror"},{"id":"p13s12","text":" via `https://eu.s.jina.ai` |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- DSH web profile (`dsh web`), Node.js ≥ 22.19 — the same floor as DSH itself (`^22.19.0 || >=24`). "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"Source installs from GitHub run the `prepare` build, which needs the same range.
- At least one reac"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"hable upstream: the default queue works with no credentials (AnySearch anonymous); Tavily / TinyFish"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" / Brave / Exa / Firecrawl / Jina / SerpApi / Serper entries need their API keys to contribute."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"From the npm registry (prebuilt — no build permission needed):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From a GitHub repository (source — pnpm runs the `prepare` build; allowlist the package in `profiles"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` if pnpm blocks the build script):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Or through the DSH plugin marketplace (设置 → DSH插件市场) — the repo carries the `dsh-plugin` topic and i"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s indexed automatically."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"After a bundle plugin is added to the profile layer stack, **restart `dsh web`** for it to load; uni"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"nstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-aggregation` and restart again."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The Plugins page (侧边栏 → 插件) opens the form one click from the list: the *dsh-web-search-aggregation*"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" card's **查看** lands on the package page with the full form between its description and its rows; th"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"e row's own **配置** control opens the same form under the plugin's title. It edits the `web-search-ag"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"gregation` settings section — derived from the plugin entry's `Config` schema — live:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Search queries and API keys leave the machine only toward the endpoints configured per queue entry ("},{"id":"p28s2","text":"the nine providers' official APIs by default). Keys are stored in the DSH credentials domain — never"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" in the settings file, never logged, never echoed back to the client. Failure records and logs cite "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"masked references (`TAVILY_API_KEY#2`), not literals. No result data is retained beyond the session "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"(`TAVILY_API_KEY#2`), not literals. No result data is retained beyond the session that requested it."}],"truncated":true}
